languageModelTools.name: opencode_list_directory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Task planning comes first: before workspace tools, create or update the visible task card. For multi-step work, publish a concise plan of actionable outcomes before investigation or edits; keep stable steps and at most one in_progress. Update the card after each meaningful completed step or change in direction, then mark the next step in_progress. Simple requests do not need an artificial multi-step plan; use a lightweight task status without padding steps or listing individual tool calls. Before the final answer reconcile the card: completed only when the requested work and validation are done; otherwise report blocked or cancelled truthfully. Use Bridge set_todos or Bridge update_plan; a client-local plan does not update this card. List one or two levels of a known workspace directory. Prefer this over recursive file search when you simply need to see what a directory contains. With OpenCode Bridge MCP, call Bridge set_todos (or Bridge update_plan) before other tools: new_task=true for new work, acknowledged task_id/revision only for the same unfinished job. Ended cards are sealed; blocked/interrupted cards may only update existing steps. A client-local plan or report_progress is not durable; send a completed/blocked snapshot before the final answer. If both writers fail, continue without repeated task-card retries and say the OpenCode task card was not synchronized; never claim unacknowledged updates. All task-card titles, steps, phase labels, progress updates and explanations shown to users must use Simplified Chinese; keep protocol names/enums English.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the contents of a workspace directory.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_run_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Task planning comes first: before workspace tools, create or update the visible task card. For multi-step work, publish a concise plan of actionable outcomes before investigation or edits; keep stable steps and at most one in_progress. Update the card after each meaningful completed step or change in direction, then mark the next step in_progress. Simple requests do not need an artificial multi-step plan; use a lightweight task status without padding steps or listing individual tool calls. Before the final answer reconcile the card: completed only when the requested work and validation are done; otherwise report blocked or cancelled truthfully. Use Bridge set_todos or Bridge update_plan; a client-local plan does not update this card. Run native bash source directly in a OpenCode-managed independent Bash PTY on Linux, macOS and Windows, not the user's configured terminal profile; do not add a bash -lc wrapper around ordinary commands. Do not infer PowerShell, CMD or zsh from the host OS. On macOS /bin/bash is 3.2; Windows uses product-bundled PortableGit Bash. Idle owner-scoped terminals with the same cwd are reused and close automatically after two hours; concurrent or busy commands may use additional terminals. background defaults to false; use true only for long-running servers/watchers. Commands require user confirmation when invoked from Chat. Terminal reuse: reuse an idle terminal belonging to the same command owner and matching an explicit cwd. Omit cwd to continue in that owner's most recently used idle shell; a new shell starts at the first workspace root. Windows native drive paths and equivalent MSYS paths identify the same cwd. Managed terminals stay in the terminal panel; terminal_id identifies a shell session, not an application window. Pool limit: 8 managed terminals. TERMINAL_POOL_LIMIT means all slots are busy: inspect existing command_id handles with get_command_output, wait for completion, or cancel only an authorized command. Do not retry in a tight loop or change client identity to bypass the limit. Use read_files/search_files and apply_patch for supported file work; batch independent reads. PowerShell from Bash: protect a powershell.exe -Command script with Bash single quotes, or use a short .ps1 file for complex quoting. Bash double quotes still expand $variables, $(), and backticks before PowerShell sees them; this includes $_. Avoid large -EncodedCommand payloads: use file tools for data and a small script for execution. With OpenCode Bridge MCP, call Bridge set_todos (or Bridge update_plan) before other tools: new_task=true for new work, acknowledged task_id/revision only for the same unfinished job. Ended cards are sealed; blocked/interrupted cards may only update existing steps. A client-local plan or report_progress is not durable; send a completed/blocked snapshot before the final answer. If both writers fail, continue without repeated task-card retries and say the OpenCode task card was not synchronized; never claim unacknowledged updates. All task-card titles, steps, phase labels, progress updates and explanations shown to users must use Simplified Chinese; keep protocol names/enums English.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a command in a OpenCode-managed integrated terminal.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_get_command_output
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read incremental output and status from a command previously started by OpenCode. Pass only the exact opaque cmd_... command_id token, not terminal_id or adjacent output lines.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read output from a running or completed OpenCode command.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_cancel_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cancel a managed command by its random owner-scoped command_id capability. Default behavior is soft interrupt only and never auto-forces. If force_required=true, force=true requires host-owned local confirmation and can close only that managed PTY; protected packaging, signing, install, migration, archive/restore, and bulk-move operations cannot be force-cancelled. Idempotent on final states; do not send Ctrl+C as interactive text.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_send_command_input
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Send input to a running OpenCode integrated terminal command. Pass only the exact opaque cmd_... command_id token, not terminal_id or adjacent output lines.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send text to a running OpenCode command.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_get_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read current diagnostics from VS Code and active language services for the workspace or a scoped file/directory.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read current editor and language-service diagnostics.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_lsp
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigate code semantically using the language services already active in VS Code. Use for workspace/document symbols, definitions, references, implementations, and hover/type information. Results include provider_state, project_anchor, project_anchor_source, warmup_performed, and semantic_result_inconclusive metadata so empty semantic results and heuristic warm-up anchors are not over-interpreted. project_anchor_source=warmup_candidate means the anchor is only a project-activation hint, not proof that the symbol was found there. Prefer this for code symbols; use search_files for raw text and read_files for implementation details after locating the symbol.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Navigate definitions, references, symbols, implementations, and hover information through active language services.

path.description: Workspace source path. Workspace-relative is preferred; absolute paths are accepted only when they remain inside the workspace. For workspace_symbols this is optional and may be a project/file/directory anchor.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_wait
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Block for a fixed amount of time, then return. Use to let a background command (run_command with background=true) make progress before reading its output with get_command_output, or to give a server/watcher time to emit more output. Choose one wait long enough for the expected work (e.g. 10-30 seconds for builds, up to 120 seconds for slow compiles) instead of polling get_command_output in a tight loop. The wait only sleeps; it does not check command status.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Wait a fixed amount of time.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_github
languageModelTools.userDescription: 用你登录的 GitHub 账号访问 Issue、PR、评论、审查、Actions、Release、搜索等。
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call the GitHub API as the signed-in user. Use it for anything on GitHub: issues, pull requests (files, diffs, reviews, review comments, merge), comments, labels, milestones, branches, commits, compare, contents, releases, Actions workflows/runs/logs, checks, gists, notifications, code/issue search, repos and users. REST: set method (default GET) and path, e.g. '/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues', '/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/12/files', '/search/issues'; '{owner}' and '{repo}' are replaced with the current workspace's GitHub origin. Put URL parameters in query (per_page up to 100, page). Use body for POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE payloads. For a PR diff use accept 'application/vnd.github.v3.diff'. GraphQL: set graphql (and variables); '{owner}'/'{repo}' are replaced there too. The result starts with 'HTTP <status>' and a 'link' header for pagination. Write operations ask the user to confirm first. Prefer this tool over running gh/curl in the terminal.

method.description: HTTP method for REST calls. Default GET.

path.description: REST path on api.github.com, e.g. /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?state=open or /user. Ignored when graphql is set.

graphql.description: GraphQL query or mutation. When set, path/method are ignored.

accept.description: Accept header, e.g. application/vnd.github.v3.diff for a PR diff. Default application/vnd.github+json.

max_chars.description: Truncate the response to this many characters. Default 60000.

languageModelTools.name: opencode_confirm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Internal UI helper OpenCode uses to ask the user for confirmation inside the chat. Never call this tool yourself.
languageModelTools.userDescription: OpenCode 内部使用：在聊天里请求你确认

opencode.model.baseUrl.description: OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible base URL used by OpenCode.

opencode.update.source.markdownDescription: OpenCode 更新来源。填 GitHub 公开仓库 `owner/name`（读取 releases/latest），或包含 `latest.json`（`{version, notes, url 或 path}`）的本地/共享文件夹路径。留空（默认）= 不检查更新、不联网。启动时每天最多检查一次，也可运行「OpenCode: 检查更新」。

opencode.cloudAgent.repo.markdownDescription: 「发到云端运行」的目标 GitHub 仓库 `owner/repo`。留空（默认）= 自动使用当前工作区 git remote（优先 origin）指向的仓库；识别不到时才用这里的值，仍为空则弹框询问。

opencode.cloudAgent.model.markdownDescription: 云端智能体使用的模型 id（传给工作流输入 `model`）。留空 = 使用 `opencode.model.name`；两者都为空时用仓库变量 `OPENCODE_MODEL` 或运行器默认值。

opencode.cloudAgent.secretName.markdownDescription: 保存模型 API Key 的 GitHub 仓库 Secret 名称（只在 GitHub Secrets 中保存，OpenCode 不读取、不记录密钥）。可选：Secret 或变量 `OPENCODE_API_BASE` 指定 OpenAI 兼容地址。

opencode.model.name.description: Model identifier exposed in the native Chat model picker and used by the OpenCode Agent Runtime.

opencode.chat.bridgeStyleUI.description: Render OpenCode Chat tool activity with the compact Bridge-inspired card style. This setting does not change Bridge mode.

opencode.chat.aiTitle.description: Use the current chat model to generate a short title for new chats. When off, the first message is used as the title.

enumDescriptions: 每次询问：终端命令、文件修改与 MCP 工具调用前都要确认
自动允许：工具调用不再弹出确认
全自动：同「自动允许」，并且 AI 的所有提问直接采用推荐项（对话里留记录），交接自动发送；单独设为询问 / 禁止的类别和工具仍优先
只读：只允许读取类工具，禁止修改文件、运行命令与未单独允许的 MCP 工具
opencode.chat.permissionMode.description: OpenCode 原生 Chat 的工具权限模式（对话面板标题行「权限」按钮）：每次询问 / 自动允许 / 全自动 / 只读。不影响 Bridge 远程调用，Bridge 仍由自身规则与门禁约束。

opencode.chat.mcpPermissions.description: OpenCode 原生 Chat 的 MCP 工具权限：servers 按服务器名、tools 按工具 ID 设置 allow / ask / deny；工具优先于服务器，未设置时跟随 opencode.chat.categoryPermissions 的 mcp 类别，再跟随 opencode.chat.permissionMode。

opencode.chat.categoryPermissions.description: OpenCode 原生 Chat 按类别的工具权限（「权限」›「更多」）：terminal 终端命令、edit 修改文件、read 读取文件、search 搜索与列目录、diagnostics 诊断与 LSP、screen 屏幕/摄像头查看、memoryRead 读取记忆与技能、memoryWrite 写入记忆、tasks 任务卡与计划、collab Bridge 协作与规则、mcpConfig 配置 MCP 服务器、custom 自定义工具、mcp MCP 工具、branchCommand 多模型后台分支终端命令、worktreeEdit 隔离工作树改动。未设置的类别跟随 opencode.chat.permissionMode。优先级：单个工具 > MCP 服务器 > 类别 > 模式。

opencode.chat.toolPermissions.description: OpenCode 原生 Chat 按单个工具名的权限（如 run_command、apply_patch、custom_xxx），优先于类别与模式；MCP 工具用 opencode.chat.mcpPermissions.tools。

opencode.chat.sharedHistory.description: Synchronize native local chat history across all OpenCode windows and instances on this PC through the shared workspace hub. Shared records are read-only outside their owning workspace. Original workspace history is retained as a compatibility backup.

opencode.runtime.entryPoint.description: Optional absolute path to dist/src/agent-host.js. The OpenCode carrier normally injects this automatically.

opencode.bridge.ngrokDomain.description: Initial import source for Rules Center only. Existing saved presets and workspace bindings are not overwritten by settings defaults or release changes.

opencode.rules.allowLegacyMigration.description: Explicitly allow upgrading legacy shared rule schemas 1/2/3 to stable schema 4 after a backup. This can make unsupported old versions unable to read the shared store. Leave disabled unless every version using this store supports schema 4; startup never silently migrates by default.

opencode.rules.dataDirectory.description: Optional absolute, dedicated directory for shared rule presets and collaboration data. Empty uses the stable OpenCode/shared-automation directory in the current OS user's data area, independent of application versions. Existing saved rules are never replaced by release defaults. OPENCODE_AUTOMATION_HOME overrides this for explicitly isolated profiles.

opencode.bridge.customInstructions.deprecationMessage: Use OpenCode: Rules Center. Existing global and workspace text is imported only when the shared rules store is first created; later release defaults never reset saved presets or bindings.
opencode.bridge.customInstructions.description: Optional custom text appended to the Bridge MCP server instructions (the system prompt remote agents receive on connect). Leave empty to send only the built-in instructions. Applies to the next remote connection; use \n for line breaks.

opencode.bridge.ngrokUseHttpProxy.description: Let the ngrok tunnel process use the resolved VS Code/system HTTP proxy. Requires an ngrok Pay-as-you-go plan; ngrok Free rejects HTTP proxies with ERR_NGROK_9009. Keep this off to run ngrok in direct connection mode.

enumDescriptions: Connect directly first; if no Cloudflare edge connection registers and an HTTP proxy is configured (http.proxy or the system proxy), carry the Quick Tunnel through that proxy.
Always connect to the Cloudflare edge directly (QUIC, falling back to HTTP/2).
Always carry the Quick Tunnel through the HTTP proxy (HTTP/2 over CONNECT to port 7844).
opencode.bridge.cloudflareEdgeRoute.markdownDescription: How the Cloudflare Quick Tunnel reaches the Cloudflare edge. cloudflared cannot use an HTTP proxy for this connection, so for the proxy route OpenCode runs a local relay that carries it through `http.proxy` or the system proxy with CONNECT; the proxy must allow CONNECT to port 7844. The Quick Tunnel always runs with its own cloudflared config, so `~/.cloudflared/config.yml` does not apply.

opencode.bridge.cloudflareNamedDomain.description: Fixed HTTPS hostname configured as a Cloudflare Tunnel published application, for example mcp.example.com.

opencode.bridge.cloudflareNamedLocalPort.description: Fixed localhost port used by Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Configure the Cloudflare published application Service URL as http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

opencode.bridge.tailscalePath.description: Path to tailscale.exe for the Tailscale Funnel tunnel. Empty: Program Files, E:\ai工作区\tailscale\bin, then PATH.

opencode.bridge.tailscaleSocket.description: tailscaled named pipe for the Tailscale Funnel tunnel. Empty: default for installed Tailscale, or \\.\pipe\tailscale-ai for a portable copy with tailscaled.exe next to tailscale.exe.

opencode.bridge.elicitation.description: Bridge 用 bridge_ask_user 提问时，同时向支持 MCP elicitation 表单的客户端推送一份等价表单，哪边先回答就用哪边。默认关闭。

opencode.bridge.checkpoints.description: 影子 git 检查点：每次 apply_patch、写文件或 run_command 成功后，在 .opencode/shadow-git 自动保存一次工作区快照（不碰项目自己的 .git），并提供 bridge_checkpoints 工具（list / restore / fork）。默认关闭。

opencode.bridge.specMode.description: Spec 模式：开启后新建的任务卡，要先依次提交 需求→设计→任务 三段规格（写在 .opencode/specs/），每段都要在任务卡上评审通过；三段全部通过前，Bridge 拒绝写文件和执行命令。默认关闭。

enumDescriptions: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. No account or domain required; the public URL changes after restart.
Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Stable hostname; requires a Cloudflare account, managed domain, Tunnel Token, and published application route.
ngrok reserved domain. Requires an ngrok account, Authtoken, and configured domain.
Tailscale Funnel. Fixed https://<machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net address; requires Tailscale login with HTTPS and Funnel enabled.
opencode.bridge.tunnelProvider.description: Public tunnel provider used by OpenCode Bridge.

opencode.bridge.persistentMode.description: Open OpenCode in Bridge mode and start the Bridge automatically after the Chat view has finished rendering.

enumDescriptions: Project files. Restrict file tools to opened workspaces and global Skills; outside paths are not file-tool roots.
Entire device (default). Bridge file tools can access local device paths subject to operating-system permissions and the current task authorization; relative paths still prefer opened workspaces.
opencode.bridge.workspaceScope.description: Bridge file-tool access defaults to Entire device. Choose Project files to restrict access. Existing explicit choices are preserved; relative paths prefer open workspaces.

opencode.mcp.extraCaCertificates.markdownDescription: Optional PEM file with additional root certificates for shared stdio MCP servers (passed as `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, appended to the built-in list). A path, not a secret; leave empty to use the system certificates.

opencode.bridge.startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the public Bridge health endpoint after the tunnel reports readiness. Deterministic network failures (DNS or connection refused) abort startup earlier regardless of this limit.

opencode.bridge.copyPromptText.default: 使用上方 MCP_URL_BASE64，用 Bash 连接 MCP，然后调用 start。这是我电脑mcp工具打开的隧道，用于让你直接修改或查看我电脑项目，用于我的学习或开发
opencode.bridge.copyPromptText.markdownDescription: Text the Bridge page's **Copy prompt** button places after the MCP address. The address is always taken from the running Bridge and is never read from this setting, so editing it cannot produce a stale or wrong endpoint. Leave empty to use the built-in default.

opencode.bridge.startupPinPage.description: 每次重启软件或新建窗口时自动将 Bridge 设置页置顶并固定，替换默认欢迎页。关闭时恢复默认配置。
opencode.bridge.startupPinPage.markdownDescription: Automatically pin and bring the Bridge settings page to the front on every software restart and new window, replacing the default welcome page. When disabled, the default startup configuration is restored.

opencode.bridge.settingsPageFloating.description: 在窗口内的悬浮卡中独立显示 Bridge 设置，可拖动、不再平铺在设置页背景里。关闭时 Bridge 设置嵌入设置页（默认）。
opencode.bridge.settingsPageFloating.markdownDescription: Render the Bridge settings in a draggable floating card inside the window instead of filling the embedded settings page. When disabled (default), the Bridge settings stay embedded in the settings page.

enumDescriptions: Restore only the last closed window on startup (default).
Restore all windows from the previous session on startup.
opencode.windowRestore.description: How OpenCode restores windows on startup.

opencode.bridge.quickLinks.description: Custom quick-open shortcuts shown as buttons at the top of the Bridge page. Each opens in the OpenCode built-in browser.

opencode.bridge.toolConcurrency.markdownDescription: Maximum built-in Bridge tool concurrency. Fair per-owner/resource pools; adaptive pressure control can shrink below this ceiling. External MCP and live command processes use separate budgets. Restart the extension host after changing.

opencode.bridge.skillsEnabled.markdownDescription: 加载全局和当前项目 Skill。关闭后不再作为 MCP 工具提供；不改变各 Skill 的全局启停状态，JSON 工具不受影响。可在 Bridge 下方的 Skill 页面管理。

opencode.multiModel.enabled.description: Enable multi-model rounds. Different models answer the same question from the context before the previous round, each branch editing code in its own git worktree; the merge model reads all branches, verifies when necessary, and produces consensus, disagreements, and the final change. Only adopted branches continue into subsequent context. When disabled, an empty input no longer triggers branch sending.

opencode.multiModel.mergeModel.description: Merge model in vendor/modelId format. Leave empty to use the model selected in the current conversation when merging.

opencode.multiModel.mergeReadTools.description: Allow the merge model to perform read-only file verification when merging. Files are read only when branches disagree or the conclusion lacks evidence.

opencode.multiModel.maxBranches.description: Maximum number of branches per round. When the limit is reached, merge or adopt a branch before generating more branches for the same question.

opencode.multiModel.parallelBranches.description: How many branch models "Multi-Model Branches" runs at the same time (including the one shown live). 1 runs them one after another. Background branches run their terminal commands without per-command chat confirmation, inside the isolated branch worktree in Code mode; workspace rules still apply.

opencode.multiModel.mergeReasoningEffort.description: Thinking effort used by the merge model when summarizing branches. Only applies when opencode.multiModel.mergeModel is set to a separate merge model; otherwise merging follows the thinking setting of the current conversation. If the merge model does not support the selected effort (DeepSeek supports low/high/max only; Codex models cannot disable thinking or use Ultra), the merge model default effort is used instead.

opencode.multiModel.branchModels.description: Models used by the Multi-Model Branches button, in vendor/modelId format and in order. Models that already answered the current round are skipped; the count is limited by opencode.multiModel.maxBranches.

opencode.multiModel.branchRoles.description: Per-model branch perspective, keyed by vendor/modelId: critic, alternative, minimal or verifier. Applies to every branch answered by that model; merging labels each branch with its role.

opencode.multiModel.codeBranches.description: Allow multi-model branches in Code mode. A git snapshot is taken before each Code answer; every branch edits code in its own git worktree and shows a diff that can replace or be layered onto the workspace.

opencode.multiModel.autoMerge.description: After Multi-Model Branches finishes and at least two complete branches exist, run Merge & Summarize automatically.

opencode.terminal.pipelineExitCodes.description: Include pipeline_exit_codes (per-command Bash PIPESTATUS) in run_command and get_command_output responses.

opencode.memory.scratchDirectory.description: 临时 MCP 的专属记忆目录路径。留空时使用 OpenCode 共享自动化目录下的 scratch-memory。临时 MCP 默认拥有整机权限（Entire device），其需求、随手记与临时交接存放在此处，不污染任何工作区项目记忆。

opencode.memory.autoHandoff.description: 任务或会话结束时，是否自动将工作进展与交接单归档至记忆中。

opencode.tools.deferLoading.description: 工具较多时（超过 24 个）只发送核心工具的完整定义，其余工具由模型通过 tool_search 按需加载，以减少每轮请求的 token 并加快首句回复。关闭后每轮都发送全部工具定义。

opencode.context.maxImages.description: 每次请求最多带上最近的几张图片（截图、看屏幕结果、用户附图）；更早的图片换成一行占位文字以节省上下文。最新一条用户消息的图片始终保留。0 = 不限制。

opencode.goal.maxRounds.description: /goal 目标循环默认最多跑几轮（每轮是一次完整的 agent 运行）。可在命令里用 --max 覆盖，上限 50。

opencode.goal.checkTimeoutSeconds.description: /goal 的 --check 验收命令单次最长运行秒数，超时按未通过处理。

opencode.commands.maxConcurrent.description: 同时运行的前台命令上限（所有对话合计，后台命令不计）。达到上限时新命令排队最多 60 秒，然后照常启动并附提示，从不拒绝。留空 = max(4, CPU 逻辑核数)；0 = 不限制。环境变量 OPENCODE_MAX_RUNNING_COMMANDS 优先。

opencode.context.autoCompact.description: 上下文接近模型窗口上限时自动压缩对话（生成检查点并保留最近内容）。

opencode.context.compactThreshold.description: dsh 触发比例 ratio（0.3–0.98）。与 dsh 一致：触发点 = min(ratio×窗口, 窗口−预留输出−65536)，留空（默认）ratio=0.8；没有下限，窗口−预留输出−65536≤0 时跳过自动压缩并提示一次。

opencode.context.keepRecentTokens.description: 压缩时原样保留的最近对话 token 数（固定值）。留空或 0（默认）时与 dsh 一致：16%×(窗口−预留输出)；必须小于触发点，否则跳过自动压缩并提示一次。

opencode.context.readAgentsMd.description: 原生对话每轮读取工作区根目录到当前/附加文件所在目录的 AGENTS.md 与 CLAUDE.md，作为始终生效的项目说明（越具体的越优先）。

opencode.context.agentsMdBudgetBytes.description: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 每轮最多带入的总字节数；超出时优先保留更具体（更深目录）的文件。

opencode.custom.enabled.description: 启用自定义指令（.opencode/commands/*.md）和自定义工具（.opencode/tools/*.json）。用户级目录为 ~/.opencode，工作区级为 <工作区>/.opencode，重名时工作区优先。

opencode.custom.paths.description: 额外的自定义目录（每个目录下放 commands/ 和 tools/）。

opencode.chat.autoApproveReadOnlyCommand.markdownDescription: 权限为「每次询问」时，只读终端命令（如 `git status`、`ls`、`rg`、`Get-Content`、任意程序的 `--version`）自动执行，不再弹确认。含重定向、`$( )`、变量展开或写操作的命令仍需确认。

opencode.chat.commandAllowlist.markdownDescription: 权限为「每次询问」时自动执行的命令前缀，例如 `npm test`、`pnpm build`、`python -m pytest`。串联命令要求每一段都在白名单或属于只读命令。

opencode.chat.trackEdits.markdownDescription: 把 AI 用 apply_patch 做的修改记入对话编辑会话：对话里列出改动的文件，可逐个保留 / 撤销，并可「恢复到检查点」回到某一轮之前。
